findings: Stage 13 repair: use one unambiguous phase namespace for the five closing recap items. They are stored in phases.transfer and execution_sequence calls the phase transfer, while completion_thresholds also calls it transfer, but phase_terminal_rules, overall_mastery, and FINISH eligibility call the same path recap. As assembled, a controller keyed by the execution phase has no transfer terminal rule and cannot waterproofly establish the terminal outcome required by FINISH. Rename or explicitly map this phase consistently across execution, thresholds, terminal rules, mastery, and finish eligibility without changing the five frozen prompts.
